originalEntry.title: Particle-illustration Santa Monica beach
originalEntry.title_zh: 粒子插画风圣莫尼卡海滩
originalEntry.author: ishuagra02
originalEntry.description: A 3D Santa Monica beach drawn with thousands of glowing specks and ribbon strokes that shifts with the time of day; Opus also made its promo video.
originalEntry.description_zh: 用成千上万个发光粒子和飘带笔触画出的 3D 圣莫尼卡海滩，会随时段变化；宣传视频也是 Opus 做的。
originalEntry.prompt: Create a stylistic 3D environment of a busy Santa Monica beach that adapts to the time of day. The art style must be a particle illustration, which uses thousands of tiny glowing specks rather than solid fills with flowing ribbon strokes behind figures to suggest motion.
originalEntry.prompt_zh: 创建一个风格化的 3D 环境：一片热闹的圣莫尼卡海滩，会随一天中的时段变化。画风必须是粒子插画，用成千上万个发光的小点代替实心填充，并在人物身后加上流动的飘带笔触来表现动感。
originalEntry.note: Author: 2–3 more prompts on top of this one.
originalEntry.note_zh: 作者称在这条之后又追加了 2–3 条提示词。

styleClassificationSource.prompt:
Create a stylistic 3D environment of a busy Santa Monica beach that adapts to the time of day. The art style must be a particle illustration, which uses thousands of tiny glowing specks rather than solid fills with flowing ribbon strokes behind figures to suggest motion.

I had 2-3 more prompts on top of this, but this is a good starting point.
